# standpoint modality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/standpointModality>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The belief value a standpoint assigns the annotated proposition — *how* the standpoint holds it, not merely *that* it holds it. This single axis is at least as expressive as BOTH the Standpoint-Logic modal operators (□_S / ◊_S) AND the [CRMinf](../../external/ontologies.md#target-crminf) belief value (true / false / probable / possible): [`gmeow:unequivocal`](../individuals/gmeow-unequivocal.md) (□, settled true), [`gmeow:probable`](../individuals/gmeow-probable.md) (likely true), [`gmeow:conceivable`](../individuals/gmeow-conceivable.md) (◊, possible), [`gmeow:refuted`](../individuals/gmeow-refuted.md) (□¬, settled false — the standpoint DENIES the proposition), [`gmeow:bullshit`](../individuals/gmeow-bullshit.md) (indifference to truth — Frankfurt). Optional; ABSENT is read as unequivocal. Orthogonal to [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) (our certainty about the standpoint's stance) and [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) (whose frame). Refutation is what lets GMEOW distinguish a standpoint's explicit denial from its silence — the neutral-stance ambiguity flat models cannot resolve.
